snippet.title: Relooted Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Relooted is an Africanfuturist heist game where you reclaim real life looted African artifacts from Western museums. Coming soon to Steam, the Epic Games Store, and Xbox Series X|S

Wishlist it now:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3255890/Relooted/
EGS: https://store.epicgames.com/p/relooted-89fdd7
Xbox Series X|S: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9ppp5344b3ls
